sourcesContent: import React, { useState } from 'react'; import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'; import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'; const Membership = () => { const { signUpWithEmail, updateUserProfile } = useAuth(); const navigate = useNavigate(); const [formData, setFormData] = useState({ firstName: '', lastName: '', email: '', password: '' }); const handleChange = (e) => { setFormData({ ...formData, [e.target.name]: e.target.value }); }; const handleSubmit = async (e) => { e.preventDefault(); try { const { user } = await signUpWithEmail(formData.email, formData.password); await updateUserProfile(user, { displayName: `${formData.firstName} ${formData.lastName}` }); alert("Welcome to Le Club Bindass!"); navigate('/profile'); } catch (error) { console.error("Signup failed:", error); alert(error.message); } }; return ( <> L'Elegance - Premium Membership
